category_title: Fourth-grade student with severe disabilities exhibiting physical aggression and escape behaviors
scenario_title: Classroom transition leading to severe physical escalation
minimal_context: Joseph is in his self-contained classroom being asked to transition to the next activity using visual supports.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joseph, it is time for our transition. Please look at the visual supports to see what we are doing next.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Displays signs of distress and frustration, pacing away from the visual supports.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Listen to my verbal prompts, Joseph. You need to calm down and come over here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes increasingly agitated as the verbal prompts continue, stepping forward and beginning to scratch Ms. Tracey.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Stop scratching right now. We need to finish this transition.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins kicking and hitting Mrs. O’Shaughnessy. As she attempts to back away, he grabs a fist-full of her hair and pulls her to the floor.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Joseph, it is time for our transition. Please look at the visual supports to see what we are doing next.

STUDENT: (Displays signs of distress and frustration, pacing away from the visual supports.)

TUTOR: Listen to my verbal prompts, Joseph. You need to calm down and come over here.

STUDENT: (Becomes increasingly agitated as the verbal prompts continue, stepping forward and beginning to scratch Ms. Tracey.)

TUTOR: Stop scratching right now. We need to finish this transition.

STUDENT: (Begins kicking and hitting Mrs. O’Shaughnessy. As she attempts to back away, he grabs a fist-full of her hair and pulls her to the floor.)

context.social_setting: Teaching team includes his primary special education teacher, Ms. Tracey, and several instructional aides

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During a transition period in the classroom when staff attempted to calm him using visual supports and verbal prompts
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Began to scratch Ms. Tracey, began kicking and hitting Mrs. O’Shaughnessy, grabbed a fist-full of her hair and pulled her to the floor
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Increasingly agitated, displaying signs of distress and frustration

behavior_patterns.condition: When returning from recess or the cafeteria (transition between school environments)
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Physically aggressive toward staff members, attacking everyone around him, shoved Ms. Tracey and she fell backwards onto a cafeteria table
